sources.independence_basis: Separate security research organizations publish original technical mechanism descriptions of the same incident without visible attribution to each other; public PoC is contextual corroboration, not a third security publisher.

identity_basis.review: BlockSec explains the fake xToken/NFT-transfer/continued-borrow mechanism and explicitly links this attack transaction. PeckShield independently explains withdrawn pledged NFTs remaining usable as collateral in the same incident, while linking a different incident transaction. The public PoC explicitly labels this hash the first Start call, distinguishing it from preparation and NFT transfer; this is contextual corroboration, not executed fixture evidence.
